4128456639.source: Makes your character immune to all damage.
4128456639.text: Membuat karaktermu kebal terhadap semua serangan.

525024608.source: Heals your ped to full health every frame.
525024608.text: Menyembuhkan karaktermu setiap frame agar tetap penuh darah.

638344572.source: Refills your character's armor and restocks all inventory armor slots.
638344572.text: Mengisi ulang armor karakter Anda dan mengisi kembali semua slot armor inventaris.

2658732694.source: Restocks all snacks in your inventory to their maximum value.
2658732694.text: Mengisi ulang semua snack di inventaris ke jumlah maksimal.

2932476165.text: Membunuh diri Anda sendiri secara instan.

3523454436.source: Changes how fast you regenerate health.

3954294902.source: Resurrects your ped immediately when dying.

3565731681.source: The Bullshark Testosterone Effect increases your health, your strength and your bullet damage.
3565731681.text: Efek Bullshark Testosterone bikin darah, kekuatan, dan damage peluru naik.

893162536.source: Off the Radar makes your player blip vanish from the map. Other players will not be able to find you on it.
893162536.text: Hilang dari Radar membuat blip pemain Anda menghilang dari peta. Pemain lain tidak akan dapat menemukan Anda di peta.

390440919.source: Reveals all players on the map that are currently Off the Radar.
390440919.text: Menunjukkan semua pemain di peta yang lagi Off the Radar.

3145340696.source: Cops Turn Blind Eye makes cops ignore all crimes you commit while the effect is active.
3145340696.text: Bikin polisi nggak peduli kejahatan yang kamu lakuin selama efek ini aktif.

1376934617.source: Thermal Vision lets you see heat signatures.
1376934617.text: Thermal Vision bikin kamu bisa lihat tanda panas.

1082739767.source: Night Vision lets you see in the dark.
1082739767.text: Night Vision bikin kamu bisa lihat di tempat gelap.

1093460158.source: Disables the cam adjustment when colliding with an entity.
1093460158.text: Matikan efek kamera yang berubah pas nabrak objek.

3046592389.source: Prevents stunt jumps from changing your camera.
3046592389.text: Mencegah lompatan akrobatik mengubah sudut kamera Anda.

1242937699.source: This will make your game's camera look like GTA 1.
1242937699.text: Bikin kamera game lo mirip GTA 1.

963575211.text: Fitur ini cuma kelihatan buat kamu sendiri.

1834134266.source: Disables the wanted system for yourself.
1834134266.text: Menonaktifkan sistem wanted level untuk dirimu sendiri.

11842258.source: Locks your wanted level at 5 stars.

4003979888.source: The ultimate police chase. All of Los Santos will be locked down and you will face a lot of different police vehicles.
4003979888.text: Kejar-kejaran polisi ultimate! Seluruh Los Santos bakal lockdown dan kamu bakal dikejar banyak polisi.

2663848349.text: Mengatur wanted level hanya secara visual.

3862336303.source: You will never run out of special ability.

1884055079.text: Menghapus semua efek visual kerusakan pada karaktermu.

2429067859.source: Third Person In Vehicle Aim FOV
2429067859.text: FOV Third Person dalam Kendaraan Saat Nge-aim

3175650608.source: Cinematic FOV is used for the Cinematic Vehicle Cam, the Stunt Jump Cam or the Idle Cam.
3175650608.text: FOV Sinematik dipakai buat mode kamera mobil sinematik, kamera stunt jump, atau idle cam.

2211315589.source: Scripted FOV is used for things like the Orbital Cannon, pressing R to focus on Points of Interest or in gameplay to zoom in on stuff.
2211315589.text: FOV scripted dipakai buat hal kayak Orbital Cannon, tekan R buat fokus ke titik tertentu, atau zoom in pas gameplay.

2568867155.source: Makes you able to fly around in noclip. Once disabled you will return to your ped's position.
2568867155.text: Membuat Anda dapat terbang bebas dalam mode noclip. Setelah dinonaktifkan, Anda akan kembali ke posisi ped Anda.

3567800255.source: Makes you able to fly around with your ped in noclip.
3567800255.text: Bikin bisa terbang bebas dengan karakter pakai NoClip.

3988838587.source: Keeps the forward speed of a vehicle from before noclip and applies it again when disabled.
3988838587.text: Mempertahankan kecepatan maju kendaraan dari sebelum noclip dan menerapkannya kembali saat dinonaktifkan.

630630652.source: Replaces Speed while you are inside an interior.
630630652.text: Menggantikan Kecepatan saat Anda berada di dalam interior.

3844709262.source: Replaces Speed Fast while you are inside an interior.
3844709262.text: Menggantikan Kecepatan Tinggi saat Anda berada di dalam interior.

627787209.source: Replaces Speed Vertical while you are inside an interior.
627787209.text: Menggantikan Kecepatan Vertikal saat Anda berada di dalam interior.

2697126539.source: Move vehicles, peds and objects like the Hulk.
2697126539.text: Pindahkan kendaraan, NPC, dan objek seperti Hulk.

1820723580.source: Disables collision with all other vehicles.
1820723580.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan semua kendaraan lain.

2877434237.source: Disables collision with all other peds.
2877434237.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan semua NPC lain.

4270076866.source: Disables collision with all kinds of objects.
4270076866.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan semua jenis objek.

4230816674.source: Disables collision with walls and buildings.
4230816674.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan dinding dan bangunan.

846124686.source: Allows you to run and jump inside interiors like the casino and Kosatka.
846124686.text: Memungkinkan Anda untuk berlari dan melompat di dalam interior seperti kasino dan Kosatka.

3172541187.source: When walking off of an edge you will be able to walk on without falling down.
3172541187.text: Saat jalan dari tepi, kamu bisa lanjut jalan di udara tanpa jatuh.

1041776426.source: Makes you able to walk under water.
1041776426.text: Bikin bisa jalan di bawah air.

2549206222.source: Makes you able to walk over water.
2549206222.text: Bikin bisa jalan di atas air.

1431304415.source: Changes how fast your character will try to run. Setting this too high will result in some Looney Tunes-like running.
1431304415.text: Mengubah seberapa cepat karakter Anda mencoba berlari. Mengaturnya terlalu tinggi akan menghasilkan gaya lari seperti di kartun Looney Tunes.

2483897808.source: Changes how fast your character will swim.

303967757.source: Makes your character unable to roll over or fall to the ground.
303967757.text: Membuat karakter Anda tidak dapat terguling atau jatuh ke tanah.

905934859.source: Makes you able to fly around like Superman.
905934859.text: Bikin bisa terbang bebas kayak Superman.

2980983716.source: Puts you high up into the air with a parachute.
2980983716.text: Menerbangkanmu tinggi ke udara dengan parasut.

939784422.source: Only syncs modifications to other players from -1 to 1.
939784422.text: Hanya sinkron dari -1 sampai 1 untuk pemain lain.

2847204340.source: Allows for normally disallowed outfits to be stored using the in-game outfit slots which are accessible through clothing stores around the map.
2847204340.text: Memungkinkan outfit yang biasanya dilarang untuk disimpan menggunakan slot outfit dalam game yang dapat diakses melalui toko pakaian di sekitar peta.

3410702296.source: Allows you to freely use your wardrobe or clothing shops to put together disallowed outfits. For example you can wear a dress and pants at the same time, which would normally only be applicable through glitches or mod menus.
3410702296.text: Bebas pakai outfit sesukamu, termasuk kombinasi yang biasanya gak bisa, kayak celana sama gaun barengan.

4291197112.source: Changes your character's width, thickness and height. Only you can see these changes.
4291197112.text: Mengubah lebar, tinggi, dan ketebalan karaktermu. Hanya terlihat olehmu sendiri.

1131939323.source: Shrinks your ped to half of its original size.
1131939323.text: Mengecilkan karakter jadi setengah ukuran normal.

2320648685.text: Berdiri Tegak Tidak Sabar di Fasilitas

3751015551.text: Berdiri Tegak dengan Ponsel di Clubhouse

1876526818.text: Duduk di Bangku Fasilitas Sambil Minum

3295097552.text: Duduk di Bangku Sambil Minum Bir

185824123.text: Duduk di Bangku Fasilitas Sambil Makan

2610531699.text: Duduk di Kursi Sambil Minum Bir

124315152.text: Duduk di Kursi Lipat Sambil Minum

3419169314.source: Makes your character jack cars like Michael, Franklin or Trevor, with story mode's armed jacks when you hold a gun. Other players see them when you jack an NPC.
3419169314.text: Membuat karakter Anda membajak mobil seperti Michael, Franklin, atau Trevor, dengan pembajakan bersenjata ala mode cerita saat Anda memegang senjata. Pemain lain dapat melihat animasi ini saat Anda merebut mobil dari NPC.

3869929186.source: Makes your character jack cars like Michael, Franklin and Trevor in turn, in a shuffled order.
3869929186.text: Membuat karakter Anda membajak mobil seperti Michael, Franklin, dan Trevor secara bergantian dalam urutan acak.

3057884318.source: Clone the player's ped and spawn it next to them.
3057884318.text: Kloning ped pemain dan spawn di samping mereka.

68209203.source: Spawn an exact copy of the player's vehicle.
68209203.text: Spawn salinan persis dari kendaraan pemain.

2958792701.source: Adds the player to the list of saved players.
2958792701.text: Nambahin pemain ke daftar pemain yang disimpan.

2838420221.source: Copy the Rockstar ID of the selected player to your clipboard.
2838420221.text: Nyimpen Rockstar ID pemain yang dipilih ke clipboard.

478740678.source: If another Cherax user has loaded the same DLC model as you, it will automatically sync the same model which you see. If another player does not have the same DLC model loaded, they will see a legit model instead of the custom one. If you enable this, it will force the same model you have to sync to their machine.
478740678.text: Jika pengguna Cherax lain telah memuat model DLC yang sama dengan Anda, game akan secara otomatis menyinkronkan model yang sama yang Anda lihat. Jika pemain lain tidak memuat model DLC yang sama, mereka akan melihat model standar game alih-alih model kustom. Jika Anda mengaktifkan ini, fitur ini akan memaksa model yang sama dengan milik Anda tersinkronisasi ke perangkat mereka.

952945961.source: Hides all players in the session from the player. They will not be able to see anyone.
952945961.text: Menyembunyikan semua pemain di sesi dari pemain target. Mereka tidak akan dapat melihat siapa pun.

1050732371.source: Hides the player ped from everyone besides you.
1050732371.text: Menyembunyikan pemain dari semua orang kecuali kamu.

4214327806.source: Hides the player ped locally and only for you. It automatically reappears when you are near enough after disabling this feature.
4214327806.text: Menyembunyikan pemain hanya untuk kamu. Mereka akan muncul kembali saat kamu cukup dekat setelah menonaktifkan fitur ini.

73210667.source: Makes the player have a black screen.

1947610419.source: Kicks the player from their current Organization/Motorcycle Club.
1947610419.text: Mengeluarkan pemain dari Organisasi/MC mereka saat ini.

1572128560.source: Teleport to the selected player's waypoint.
1572128560.text: Teleport ke waypoint pemain yang dipilih.

2205117214.text: Masuk ke kendaraan pemain yang dipilih.

3170312990.source: Sends the player to your waypoint, if you have one.
3170312990.text: Mengirim pemain ke waypoint kamu, jika ada.

1881908510.source: Sends the player to their waypoint, if they have one.
1881908510.text: Mengirim pemain ke waypoint mereka, jika mereka punya.

2320716298.source: Sends the player to the abandoned mines.
2320716298.text: Mengirim pemain ke tambang yang terbengkalai.

401418637.source: Sends the player to the top of Mt. Chilliad.
401418637.text: Mengirim pemain ke puncak Gunung Chiliad.

2188313905.source: Sends the player to the top of the Maze Bank building.
2188313905.text: Mengirim pemain ke puncak gedung Maze Bank.

3143773388.source: Sends the player to a secret laboratory.

384744190.source: Sends the player to a dark room.

89820665.source: Give the player full health and armor.
89820665.text: Isi darah dan armor pemain sampai full.

3935896502.source: Only works when the target player has unlocked Ballistic Armor.
3935896502.text: Cuma bisa dipakai kalau pemain udah unlock Armor Balistik.

4018237476.source: Gives the player ammo for their current weapon.
4018237476.text: Ngasih peluru buat senjata yang lagi dipakai pemain.

2506262989.source: Unlocks the "Trust No One" torso tattoo for the player.
2506262989.text: Buka tattoo "Trust No One" buat pemain.

4066078262.source: Turns the player into an animal during Halloween.
4066078262.text: Mengubah pemain menjadi hewan selama Halloween.

715390672.source: Puts the player into the back of a stockade van that drives around randomly.
715390672.text: Memasukkan pemain ke belakang mobil Stockade yang berjalan secara acak.

1683344389.source: Ram the player with a random vehicle.

1660126089.source: Spawn a random hostile and armed ped near the player.
1660126089.text: Mengirim NPC bersenjata yang menyerang pemain.

3318201341.source: Spawn a hostile Jesus armed with a railgun near the player.
3318201341.text: Mengirim NPC Jesus yang bersenjata railgun untuk menyerang pemain.

3693665338.source: Spawn a random bodyguard ped near the player.
3693665338.text: Mengirim NPC bodyguard ke dekat pemain.

943255808.source: Removes the player's yee-yee ass haircut, making them get them some bitches on their dick.
943255808.text: Menghilangkan potongan rambut jelek pemain, membuat mereka mendapatkan beberapa Jablay di TITIT Nya..

3124640914.source: Shoots several rockets towards the player.
3124640914.text: Menembakkan beberapa roket ke arah pemain.

3418513901.source: Traps the player in the selected cage.
3418513901.text: Menjebak pemain dalam kandang yang dipilih.

1302311589.source: Set an anonymous remote bounty of 9k on the player.
1302311589.text: Pasang bounty anonim 9K ke pemain ini.

2936574136.source: Kicks the player from their current seat and will keep blocking it for everyone except you.
2936574136.text: Mengeluarkan pemain dari kursi mereka saat ini dan akan terus memblokirnya untuk semua orang kecuali Anda.

2796356260.source: Kicks the player out of their vehicle.
2796356260.text: Cuma ngelempar pemain keluar dari mobilnya.

3850099434.source: Deletes the player's current vehicle for everyone in the session.
3850099434.text: Ngapus mobil pemain dari dunia ini buat semua orang di sesi.

4065482458.source: Blow the player's vehicle engine up.

2452689089.source: Set the player's vehicle tires on fire.
2452689089.text: Nyalain api di ban kendaraan pemain.

3931070831.source: Break off the player's vehicle wheels.

3273698510.source: Break off the player's vehicle doors.

2722290697.text: Balikin kendaraan pemain ke versi standar.

3853628844.source: Adds a ramp in front of the player's vehicle.
3853628844.text: Nambahin ram di depan kendaraan pemain.

1685150785.source: The value representing a multiplier of the vehicle's current top speed.
1685150785.text: Atur seberapa ngebut kendaraan pemain bisa jalan.

3591598970.source: Removes the player from your session using the best-suited kick method.
3591598970.text: Mengeluarkan pemain dari sesi Anda menggunakan metode kick yang paling sesuai.

3706898394.source: Removes the player from your session.

74331804.source: Kicks the player from the session using a script event.
74331804.text: Mengeluarkan pemain dari sesi menggunakan Script Event.

1306077894.source: Only works when session host. Removes the player from your session.
1306077894.text: Hanya berfungsi saat menjadi host sesi. Mengeluarkan pemain dari sesimu.

871864113.source: Adds the player to saved players and enables block join. After that the player will be kicked.
871864113.text: Menambahkan pemain ke daftar pemain yang diblokir untuk bergabung dan langsung mengeluarkannya dari sesi.

3673787850.source: Send the player to an infinite loading screen.
3673787850.text: Bikin pemain masuk ke layar loading tanpa batas.

3635888998.source: Explodes the player as if they were hit by an orbital strike.
3635888998.text: Meledakkan pemain seolah-olah mereka terkena serangan orbital strike.

781307661.source: Block incoming entity syncs from a specific player.
781307661.text: Blokir sinkronisasi objek masuk dari pemain tertentu.

3182672795.source: Block outgoing entity syncs to a specific player.
3182672795.text: Blokir sinkronisasi objek keluar ke pemain tertentu.

898755470.source: Block incoming script events from a specific player.
898755470.text: Blokir script event masuk dari pemain tertentu.

856882877.source: Block outgoing script events to a specific player.
856882877.text: Blokir script event keluar ke pemain tertentu.

676140453.source: Starts a raid on one of the player's MC businesses.
676140453.text: Mulai raid ke bisnis MC pemain.

636206938.source: Start a raid on the player's bunker.

1705808078.source: Choose a map to be used for the player position map.
1705808078.text: Pilih peta yang mau dipakai buat menunjukkan posisi pemain.

917184333.source: Restarts freemode and the scripts that run under it, like a session change that keeps you in this session.
917184333.text: Memulai ulang freemode dan skrip yang berjalan di bawahnya, seperti perpindahan sesi yang tetap menempatkanmu di sesi ini.

1692082512.source: Leaves this session and joins it again right away, without a loading screen or the sky camera.
1692082512.text: Meninggalkan sesi ini dan langsung bergabung kembali, tanpa layar pemuatan atau kamera langit.

4115724974.source: Automatically runs Seamless Rejoin after the specified time. This is primarily used to avoid the BattlEye kick that happens after a certain amount of time when a BattlEye host detects a non-BattlEye player in their session. The timer restarts when the session host changes.
4115724974.text: Secara otomatis menjalankan Seamless Rejoin setelah waktu yang ditentukan. Ini terutama digunakan untuk menghindari kick BattlEye yang terjadi setelah waktu tertentu ketika host BattlEye mendeteksi pemain non-BattlEye di sesinya. Timer dimulai ulang saat host sesi berubah.

2094999927.source: Makes everyone who tries to join you join the session of the targeted Rockstar ID.
2094999927.text: Membuat semua orang yang mencoba bergabung denganmu masuk ke sesi dari Rockstar ID yang ditargetkan.

3842570106.source: Stops the matchmaking services from promoting your session to random GTA Online joiners.
3842570106.text: Hentikan layanan matchmaking supaya sesi lo gak dipromosiin ke pemain GTA Online random.

2822219617.source: Advertises your session to the matchmaking services, making people more likely to join your session.
2822219617.text: Promosiin sesi lo ke layanan matchmaking supaya lebih banyak pemain yang gabung.

2269959258.source: Advertise your session as being in a different region, so players searching that region find it.
2269959258.text: Iklankan sesimu seolah-olah berada di wilayah lain, sehingga pemain yang mencari wilayah tersebut dapat menemukannya.

1634545702.source: Makes you join sessions much faster, but can break some things. For example, you might lose your weapons upon a session change.
1634545702.text: Bikin lo masuk sesi lebih cepat, tapi bisa bikin beberapa hal rusak. Contohnya, lo bisa kehilangan senjata pas ganti sesi.

2215026371.source: This allows you to paste up to 140 chars into chat.
2215026371.text: Bisa paste teks sampai 140 karakter ke chat.

102814587.source: Press tab in chat to auto complete and iterate over all player names.
102814587.text: Tekan TAB di chat buat auto melengkapi dan scroll nama pemain yang ada.

2124262490.source: Allows you to use special characters in chat like '<' or 'N-ary summation' for the R* logo and many more.
2124262490.text: Memungkinkan kamu menggunakan karakter khusus di obrolan seperti '<' atau 'penjumlahan N-ary' untuk logo R* dan masih banyak lagi.

2926087938.source: This will visually mute the text chat. However, you will still be able to see chat messages in the Cherax console.
2926087938.text: Ini akan menyembunyikan obrolan teks secara visual. Namun, kamu tetap dapat melihat pesan obrolan di konsol Cherax.

125142855.source: Change the region the game searches when it looks for a session. Any drops the region constraint entirely.
125142855.text: Ubah wilayah yang dicari game saat mencari sesi. Opsi Sembarang akan menghapus batasan wilayah sepenuhnya.

352064883.source: Drop sessions below this player count from the game's own search. Falls back to the fullest sessions on offer when none reach it.
352064883.text: Abaikan sesi dengan jumlah pemain di bawah nilai ini dari pencarian game. Beralih ke sesi terpadat yang tersedia jika tidak ada yang mencapainya.

4018869517.source: Used to find sessions with the same asset hash.
4018869517.text: Digunakan buat nyari sesi yang punya asset hash yang sama.

329910818.source: Use this if you get errors due to an invalid asset hash or only get into empty sessions when joining other sessions.
329910818.text: Pakai ini kalau lo dapet error karena asset hash invalid atau cuma masuk sesi kosong saat nyoba join sesi lain.

248171303.source: Sets you in a "subsession", where only players in the same "subsession" can interact with you.
248171303.text: Bikin lo masuk ke 'subsession', di mana cuma pemain di subsession yang bisa interaksi sama lo.

2318030304.source: Skip confirmation alerts when joining a different session.
2318030304.text: Skip notifikasi konfirmasi saat masuk ke sesi lain.

3531844579.text: Otomatis bikin lo jadi script host.

3592752209.source: Bail from the session as if you had desynced.
3592752209.text: Keluar dari sesi seolah-olah kamu mengalami desync.

3488648411.source: Bail from the session and go into story mode.
3488648411.text: Keluar dari sesi dan masuk ke mode cerita.

2156874873.source: If you get stuck in the clouds or somewhere else and neither of the other bail options works, try this.
2156874873.text: Jika kamu tersangkut di awan atau di tempat lain dan tidak ada opsi keluar lain yang berhasil, coba opsi ini.

3273125580.text: Kecualikan diri lo dari beberapa opsi.

3176006828.source: Exclude other players from several options.
3176006828.text: Kecualikan pemain lain dari beberapa opsi.

2557026383.source: Shows players who are using invisibility, allowing you to see them even when they're hidden.
2557026383.text: Menampilkan pemain yang menggunakan mode tidak terlihat, sehingga kamu bisa melihat mereka meskipun sedang tersembunyi.

510083527.source: Clears the wanted level of all players.

3659144759.source: Trap all players in the selected cage.
3659144759.text: Jebak semua pemain dalam kandang yang dipilih.

1981980059.source: Kick a random player from your session.
1981980059.text: Kick pemain random dari sesi lo.

1094617223.source: Kick all players from your session using a simple kick.
1094617223.text: Kick semua pemain dari sesi lo pakai metode kick simpel.

3320588614.source: Crash all players in the session.
3320588614.text: Bikin semua pemain di sesi crash.

3543553489.source: Sends all players to your waypoint, if you have one.
3543553489.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke waypoint-mu, jika ada.

1459201191.source: Sends all players to a secret laboratory.
1459201191.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke laboratorium rahasia.

4156495396.source: Sends all players to a dark room.
4156495396.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke ruangan gelap.

971862175.source: Sends all players to the top of the Maze Bank building.
971862175.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke puncak Gedung Maze Bank.

430972342.source: Sends all players to the top of Mount Chiliad.
430972342.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke puncak Mount Chiliad.

740034796.source: Sends all players to the abandoned mines.
740034796.text: Mengirim semua pemain ke tambang yang terbengkalai.

1238734546.source: Other players will be unable to vote kick you. Most menus will flag you as a modder for spoofing this.
1238734546.text: Pemain lain tidak akan bisa melakukan vote kick terhadapmu. Sebagian besar menu akan menandaimu sebagai modder karena memalsukan ini.

828812507.source: Other players will be unable to vote kick you. Most menus will flag you as a modder for spoofing this.
828812507.text: Pemain lain tidak akan bisa melakukan vote kick terhadapmu. Sebagian besar menu akan menandaimu sebagai modder karena memalsukan ini.

2548451597.source: Will spoof that you are in a cheater pool.
2548451597.text: Bakal nge-spoof seolah-olah lo ada di cheater pool.

3822691345.source: Spoof your game language for other players.
3822691345.text: Spoof bahasa game lo di mata pemain lain.

2170562738.source: Select the language that will be spoofed to other players.
2170562738.text: Pilih bahasa yang bakal di-spoof ke pemain lain.

524214072.source: Other players will be unable to see you on the map or in the player list.
524214072.text: Pemain lain gak bakal bisa lihat lo di map atau daftar pemain.

768171019.source: Note: Other players might appear under the map.
768171019.text: Catatan: Pemain lain mungkin bakal muncul di bawah map.

1349858233.source: Looks like you would lag for other players. Specify the amount of player syncs that should be lost.
1349858233.text: Membuatmu terlihat lag bagi pemain lain. Tentukan jumlah sinkronisasi pemain yang harus dihilangkan.

132624240.source: Spinbot for the local player ped.

3441033758.source: Spinbot for the local player vehicle.
3441033758.text: Spinbot buat kendaraan yang dikendarai pemain lokal.

2895407763.source: Spoof your position for other players.
2895407763.text: Bikin posisi lo terlihat beda di mata pemain lain.

1282793785.source: Sets the spoofed position to your current position.
1282793785.text: Atur posisi spoof ke posisi lo sekarang.

4222251513.source: Crew ID has to exist for the crew to be displayed. The crew picture is also determined from this ID.
4222251513.text: Crew ID harus ada biar bisa ditampilkan. Gambar crew juga ditentukan dari ID ini.

3908263590.source: Will show your crew tag in a square in the player list.
3908263590.text: Bakal nampilin tag crew lo dalam kotak di daftar pemain.

3765094096.source: Spoof your score data for your session.
3765094096.text: Spoof data skor lo di sesi ini.

4175778269.source: Retrieve the current original score stats if possible.
4175778269.text: Ambil data skor asli kalau memungkinkan.

2089347071.source: Spoof the rank which other players will see in your session.
2089347071.text: Spoof level/rank lo yang bakal dilihat pemain lain di sesi ini.

552483179.source: Spoof the amount of kills you have (affects your K/D).
552483179.text: Palsukan jumlah kill yang kamu miliki (memengaruhi K/D).

1370757348.source: Spoof the amount of deaths you have (affects your K/D).
1370757348.text: Palsukan jumlah kematian yang kamu miliki (memengaruhi K/D).

2412910922.source: Spoof the amount of wallet cash you have. Can only be seen by modders.
2412910922.text: Spoof jumlah uang tunai di dompet lo. Cuma bisa dilihat sama modder.

3816877710.source: Spoof the amount of banked cash you have. Can only be seen by modders.
3816877710.text: Spoof jumlah uang di rekening bank lo. Cuma bisa dilihat sama modder.

1728581435.source: Spoof the amount of sexual acts you performed with a hooker. Can be seen by modders or through a Terrorbyte player scan.
1728581435.text: Spoof jumlah aksi seksual yang lo lakukan dengan pekerja seks. Bisa dilihat oleh modder atau melalui scan pemain di Terrorbyte.

1059962186.source: Spoof the amount of lap dances you received from a stripper. Can be seen by modders or through a Terrorbyte player scan.
1059962186.text: Palsukan jumlah lap dance yang kamu terima dari penari telanjang. Dapat dilihat oleh modder atau melalui pemindaian pemain Terrorbyte.

3120343568.source: Spinbot for all kinds of objects.

3145852605.source: A list of all owned multiplayer garages.
3145852605.text: Daftar semua garasi multiplayer yang dimiliki.

2479604754.source: A list of all saved multiplayer vehicles.
2479604754.text: Daftar semua kendaraan multiplayer yang telah disimpan.

447539156.source: Request the selected vehicle from your garage. This might take a few seconds.
447539156.text: Meminta kendaraan yang dipilih dari garasimu. Ini mungkin memakan waktu beberapa detik.

1875699399.source: Clean up your personal vehicle and put it properly back into the garage.
1875699399.text: Bersihkan kendaraan pribadimu dan masukkan kembali dengan benar ke dalam garasi.

2816017279.text: Ubah Kendaraan Saat Ini Jadi PV

268956264.source: Lets you store almost any vehicle in a garage with all its modifications.
268956264.text: Memungkinkan kamu menyimpan hampir semua kendaraan di dalam garasi beserta seluruh modifikasinya.

3329531463.source: Deletes the selected vehicle from your garage.
3329531463.text: Hapus kendaraan yang dipilih dari garasi lo.

3144191338.source: Spawn an exact copy of the current vehicle.
3144191338.text: Spawn salinan persis dari kendaraan saat ini.

828471125.source: Makes your character unable to fall out of vehicles or bikes.
828471125.text: Membuat karaktermu tidak bisa jatuh dari kendaraan atau motor.

1458836714.source: Make other cars move out of your way as if you had a siren.
1458836714.text: Membuat mobil lain menyingkir dari jalanmu seolah-olah kamu memiliki sirine.

639292904.source: Rewind your drive like in Forza Horizon while you are the driver. Press Left Arrow, or hold LB and press D-Pad Left on a controller, then rewind further, continue from there or cancel.
639292904.text: Putar balik pengendaraanmu seperti di Forza Horizon saat kamu menjadi pengemudi. Tekan Panah Kiri, atau tahan LB dan tekan D-Pad Kiri pada controller, lalu putar balik lebih jauh, lanjutkan dari sana, atau batalkan.

1144811382.source: Increases in-air control and makes performing a wheelie easier.
1144811382.text: Meningkatkan kontrol di udara dan mempermudah melakukan wheelie.

2538190953.source: Makes your vehicle fly. Press LEFT CONTROL to go down, SPACE to go up, and WASD to go sideways. Make sure to enable Bypass Max Speed.
2538190953.text: Bikin kendaraanmu bisa terbang. Tekan CTRL buat turun, SPACE buat naik, dan WASD buat arah. Pastikan Bypass Kecepatan Maksimal aktif.

3670421005.source: Boost will be applied as a percentage of your current vehicle speed.
3670421005.text: Boost bakal diterapkan sebagai persentase dari kecepatan kendaraan saat ini.

833043206.source: Speed up your vehicle while you press the horn.
833043206.text: Mempercepat kendaraanmu saat kamu membunyikan klakson.

3039138978.source: Exclude yourself from being kicked from the vehicle.
3039138978.text: Kecualikan dirimu sendiri dari ditendang keluar kendaraan.

1138575012.text: Jalan di Bawah Air dengan Kendaraan

3643836202.source: Makes your vehicle able to drive underwater.
3643836202.text: Bikin kendaraan bisa dikendarai di dalam air.

2429759967.source: Keeps your tyres at their peak grip instead of breaking away into a slide, also in the wet and offroad. Handbrake turns and burnouts still slide, and rally tyres are left as they are.
2429759967.text: Menjaga cengkeraman banmu pada kondisi puncak alih-alih tergelincir, termasuk di kondisi basah dan offroad. Tikungan rem tangan dan burnout tetap meluncur, dan ban reli dibiarkan apa adanya.

756387302.source: Makes your car radio sound loud and distorted when heard from outside your vehicle.
756387302.text: Membuat radio mobilmu terdengar keras dan terdistorsi saat didengar dari luar kendaraanmu.

3137651835.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can jump natively like some special vehicles.
3137651835.text: Menimpa kemampuan kendaraan sehingga dapat melompat secara native seperti beberapa kendaraan khusus.

220796167.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can parachute natively like a Ruiner 2000.
220796167.text: Menimpa kemampuan kendaraan sehingga dapat menggunakan parasut secara native seperti Ruiner 2000.

815380858.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can rocket boost natively like some special vehicles.
815380858.text: Menimpa kemampuan kendaraan sehingga dapat melakukan dorongan roket secara native seperti beberapa kendaraan khusus.

3926100177.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can glide natively like an Oppressor MK1.
3926100177.text: Menimpa kemampuan kendaraan sehingga dapat meluncur di udara secara native seperti Oppressor MK1.

1356298061.source: Allows your vehicle to smash everything with infinite force.
1356298061.text: Bikin kendaraan bisa nabrak apa pun dengan kekuatan tak terbatas.

3774393474.source: Disables collision with walls and buildings.
3774393474.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan dinding dan bangunan.

2892289247.source: Disables collision with all other vehicles.
2892289247.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan semua kendaraan lain.

2025031149.source: Disables collision with all kinds of objects.
2025031149.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan semua jenis objek.

2992054010.source: Disables collision with all other peds.

560511685.source: Measured in kg, mass is only responsible for the interaction between entities. Let's say it's the vehicle's pushing force. The name of this variable in the game files is fMass.
560511685.text: Diukur dalam kg, massa hanya bertanggung jawab atas interaksi antar entitas. Anggap saja ini adalah daya dorong kendaraan. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fMass.

2640041464.source: The vehicle's body air resistance. Higher resistance means an earlier perceived loss of power at higher speed, resulting in a lower top speed, as the engine cannot overpower this force. Lower air resistance allows the vehicle to travel faster on the same power. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDragCoeff.
2640041464.text: Hambatan udara bodi kendaraan. Hambatan yang lebih tinggi berarti hilangnya tenaga terasa lebih awal pada kecepatan tinggi, menghasilkan kecepatan tertinggi yang lebih rendah, karena mesin tidak dapat mengalahkan gaya ini. Hambatan udara yang lebih rendah memungkinkan kendaraan melaju lebih cepat dengan tenaga yang sama. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fInitialDragCoeff.

1519782809.source: Downforce is a way to gain grip at speed, and can be increased by spoilers. The name of this variable in the game files is fDownforceModifier.
1519782809.text: Downforce menambah grip pada kecepatan tinggi dan dapat ditingkatkan dengan spoiler. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fDownforceModifier.

2450987085.source: It dictates the target acceleration the engine is aiming for, measured in G-Forces. Wheel grip may not be able to cope with it, however. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDriveForce.
2450987085.text: Menentukan target percepatan yang ingin dicapai mesin, diukur dalam G-Forces. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fInitialDriveForce.

684547384.source: How responsive the engine revs will be to throttle control. Higher values will result in faster RPM acceleration and deceleration, while lower values will result in more sluggish RPMs. The name of this variable in the game files is fDriveInertia.
684547384.text: Seberapa responsif putaran mesin terhadap kontrol throttle. Nilai yang lebih tinggi akan menghasilkan akselerasi dan deselerasi RPM yang lebih cepat, sedangkan nilai yang lebih rendah akan menghasilkan RPM yang lebih lamban. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fDriveInertia.

1226758183.source: Top speed on the flat. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel.
1226758183.text: Top speed kendaraan di jalan datar. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel.

2298505703.source: Higher values will mean faster shifts. The name of this variable in the game files is fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift.
2298505703.text: Nilai lebih tinggi berarti perpindahan gigi lebih cepat. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift.

744861246.source: Higher values will mean faster shifts. The name of this variable in the game files is fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift.
744861246.text: Nilai lebih tinggi berarti perpindahan gigi lebih cepat. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift.

118606586.source: Defines how the power from fInitialDriveForce is distributed between the axles. 0.0 implies a fully RWD setup, which will only deliver power to the rear wheels. The name of this variable in the game files is fDriveBiasFront.
118606586.text: Menentukan bagaimana tenaga dari fInitialDriveForce didistribusikan di antara poros roda. 0.0 mengartikan pengaturan RWD penuh, yang hanya akan menyalurkan tenaga ke roda belakang. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fDriveBiasFront.

4277676405.source: Spring strength. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionForce.
4277676405.text: Kekuatan suspensi. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionForce.

3109665481.source: How strongly the spring strength is dampened when compressing or decompressing. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionCompDamp.
3109665481.text: Seberapa kuat redaman suspensi saat dikompresi. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionCompDamp.

4090980881.source: How strongly the spring strength is dampened when compressing or decompressing. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionReboundDamp.
4090980881.text: Seberapa kuat redaman suspensi saat rebound. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionReboundDamp.

4040924339.source: Compression upper limit, in meters. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionUpperLimit.
4040924339.text: Batas atas kompresi suspensi dalam meter. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionUpperLimit.

2689192344.source: Compression lower limit, in meters. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionLowerLimit.
2689192344.text: Batas bawah kompresi suspensi dalam meter. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionLowerLimit.

3102998349.source: In meters, this raises or lowers the natural stance of the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionRaise.
3102998349.text: Menyesuaikan tinggi natural kendaraan dalam meter. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionRaise.

3378618204.source: Spring strength distribution between the axles of the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionBiasFront.
3378618204.text: Distribusi kekuatan suspensi antara roda depan dan belakang. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSuspensionBiasFront.

3116600155.source: How strongly the antiroll bars try to keep the vehicle from leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fAntiRollBarForce.
3116600155.text: Seberapa kuat batang antiroll menjaga kendaraan dari miring berlebihan. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fAntiRollBarForce.

4275379701.source: Distribution of the antiroll bar strength between the car axles. The name of this variable in the game files is fAntiRollBarBiasFront.
4275379701.text: Distribusi kekuatan anti-roll bar di antara gandar mobil. Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fAntiRollBarBiasFront.

70707008.source: Relative to the model bottom, defines where the pivot point is. This is used for leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fRollCentreHeightFront.
70707008.text: Tentukan titik pivot relatif terhadap dasar model. Ini digunakan untuk kemiringan. Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fRollCentreHeightFront.

4156467570.source: Relative to the model bottom, defines where the pivot point is. This is used for leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fRollCentreHeightRear.
4156467570.text: Tentukan titik pivot relatif terhadap dasar model. Ini digunakan untuk kemiringan. Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fRollCentreHeightRear.

293634038.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fCollisionDamageMult.
293634038.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fCollisionDamageMult.

2210756519.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fWeaponDamageMult.
2210756519.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fWeaponDamageMult.

1220079591.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fDeformationDamageMult.
1220079591.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fDeformationDamageMult.

2351201883.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fEngineDamageMult.
2351201883.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fEngineDamageMult.

3252806329.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fRocketBoostCapacity.
3252806329.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fRocketBoostCapacity.

1900163724.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fBoostMaxSpeed.
1900163724.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fBoostMaxSpeed.

1613318317.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistX.
1613318317.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fSeatOffsetDistX.

2922412633.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistY.
2922412633.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fSeatOffsetDistY.

2288934142.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistZ.
2288934142.text: Nama variabel ini dalam file game adalah fSeatOffsetDistZ.

197352248.source: Give your current vehicle the drift handling of the new chop shop drift vehicles.
197352248.text: Kasih kendaraanmu handling drift kayak mobil drift baru di chop shop.

1611911543.source: Give your current vehicle the ability to fly like a Deluxo.
1611911543.text: Kasih kendaraanmu kemampuan terbang kayak Deluxo.

3765290531.source: Give your current vehicle the ability to fly like an MK2.
3765290531.text: Beri kendaraanmu saat ini kemampuan untuk terbang seperti MK2.

1478789996.source: A handling file is always associated with a specific vehicle model.
1478789996.text: File handling selalu dikaitkan dengan model kendaraan tertentu.

2855140870.source: A handling file is always associated with a specific vehicle model.
2855140870.text: File handling selalu dikaitkan dengan model kendaraan tertentu.

2107224924.source: Reset the handling of your current vehicle to default.
2107224924.text: Reset handling kendaraan lo ke pengaturan default.

2169053227.source: Reset the handling of all vehicles to default.
2169053227.text: Reset semua kendaraan ke pengaturan handling default.

1524355269.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
1524355269.text: Flags info model kendaraan yang mempengaruhi berbagai hal.

98675222.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
98675222.text: Flags info model kendaraan yang mempengaruhi berbagai hal.

1015251461.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
1015251461.text: Flags info model kendaraan yang mempengaruhi berbagai hal.

3174327335.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
3174327335.text: Flags info model kendaraan yang mempengaruhi berbagai hal.

746822079.source: How many Gs of deceleration are applied to each wheel. The name of this variable in the game files is fBrakeForce.
746822079.text: Seberapa besar G-Force pengereman diterapkan ke setiap roda. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fBrakeForce.

3315944485.source: Similar to fBrakeForce, but is only applied to the rear axle(s). The name of this variable in the game files is fHandBrakeForce.
3315944485.text: Mirip dengan fBrakeForce, tapi hanya diterapkan ke roda belakang. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fHandBrakeForce.

2122338454.source: Maximum and minimum G's the vehicle's wheels are able to pull. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveMin.
2122338454.text: Gaya maksimum dan minimum yang bisa dihasilkan oleh ban kendaraan. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fTractionCurveMin.

3458729118.source: Maximum and minimum G's the vehicle's wheels are able to pull. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveMax.
3458729118.text: Gaya maksimum dan minimum yang bisa dihasilkan oleh ban kendaraan. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fTractionCurveMax.

285714947.source: Slide angle at which the car will enjoy the best grip available. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveLateral.
285714947.text: Sudut slip di mana mobil akan mendapatkan grip terbaik. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fTractionCurveLateral.

220317698.source: Very useful for dragsters and high performance cars that come with changes like these. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionBiasFront.
220317698.text: Sangat berguna untuk dragster dan mobil berperforma tinggi yang dilengkapi dengan perubahan seperti ini. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fTractionBiasFront.

2313844976.source: Scale factor for how fast tyres lose grip. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionLossMult.
2313844976.text: Faktor skala untuk seberapa cepat ban kehilangan grip. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fTractionLossMult.

2477700197.source: How exaggerated the fake burnout grip loss is for this vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fLowSpeedTractionLossMult.
2477700197.text: Seberapa besar kehilangan cengkeraman buatan saat burnout pada kendaraan ini. Nama variabel ini di file game adalah fLowSpeedTractionLossMult.

2295409652.source: Maximum steering angle for the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSteeringLock.
2295409652.text: Sudut setir maksimum kendaraan. Variabel ini dalam game disebut fSteeringLock.

816708051.text: Ammo Tak Terbatas dalam Satu Mag

3136862601.source: Allows you to place up to 255 C4 at once.

157106628.source: You will be able to pick any weapon from your weapon wheel while inside a vehicle. Warning: This will break normal vehicle weapons like turrets.
157106628.text: Anda dapat memilih senjata apa saja dari weapon wheel saat berada di dalam kendaraan. Peringatan: Ini akan membuat senjata bawaan kendaraan seperti turret tidak berfungsi.

2938763818.source: Allows you to use all weapons in interiors.
2938763818.text: Bisa pakai semua senjata di dalam interior.

1386933639.source: Instantly lock on to your targets whether on foot or in a vehicle.
1386933639.text: Mengunci target Anda secara instan, baik saat berjalan kaki maupun di dalam kendaraan.

3523940308.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
3523940308.text: Multiplier buat recoil senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

2114829049.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
2114829049.text: Multiplier buat sebaran peluru senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

3961670324.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
3961670324.text: Multiplier buat damage senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

1714112752.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
1714112752.text: Multiplier buat kecepatan peluru senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

971985235.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
971985235.text: Multiplier buat efek dorongan senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

4034718498.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
4034718498.text: Multiplier buat efek dorongan ke NPC dari senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

695009049.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
695009049.text: Multiplier buat efek dorongan ke kendaraan dari senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

3417698787.source: A multiplier for the default value of the current weapon.
3417698787.text: Multiplier buat efek dorongan ke heli dari senjata yang dipakai sekarang.

3912989741.source: Automatically adjusts the aimbot distance to the max range of your current weapon.
3912989741.text: Menyesuaikan jarak aimbot ke jangkauan maksimal senjata lo.

549719055.source: How long in milliseconds the aimbot waits for a target that went out of sight or was overtaken before it switches to another one.
549719055.text: Berapa lama dalam milidetik aimbot menunggu target yang hilang dari pandangan atau tersalip sebelum beralih ke target lain.

672181684.source: Lets your bullets pass through vehicles, or all cover, between you and your aimbot target.
672181684.text: Membuat peluru Anda menembus kendaraan, atau semua tempat berlindung, di antara Anda dan target aimbot.

704514455.source: A zone in which your crosshair can move while the aimbot is locking onto a target.
704514455.text: Area tempat crosshair lo bisa bergerak saat aimbot mengunci target.

1691799802.source: Set your character's RP level. The last gameplay unlock comes with level 200.
1691799802.text: Atur level RP karakter lo. Unlock terakhir ada di level 200.

1312190359.source: Set your character's active crew level. The last unlock comes with level 44.
1312190359.text: Atur level crew aktif lo. Unlock terakhir ada di level 44.

2304589106.source: Claim all vehicles from Mors Mutual Insurance for free.
2304589106.text: Klaim semua kendaraan dari Mors Mutual Insurance secara gratis.

1448965669.source: Deliver all vehicles to your property instantly.
1448965669.text: Antarkan semua kendaraan ke properti lo secara instan.

4105940568.source: Makes removed and new vehicles be listed on the websites, making them available to buy.
4105940568.text: Bikin kendaraan yang dihapus dan baru muncul di website, sehingga bisa dibeli.

4115327377.source: Unlock all hair cuts, beards and makeup.
4115327377.text: Buka semua potongan rambut, jenggot, dan riasan.

2801852690.source: Unlock weapon tints, body armor, parachute bags and smoke colors.
2801852690.text: Buka corak senjata, body armor, tas parasut, dan warna asap.

3545136811.text: Bikin semua barang gratis kecuali pembelian properti baru.

2250767877.source: After setting this, go into story mode and back into online to see the changes.
2250767877.text: Setelah diaktifkan, masuk ke story mode lalu balik ke online buat lihat perubahan.

3752569983.source: Overrides all slot wheels with the values set below.
3752569983.text: Menimpa semua roda slot dengan nilai yang diatur di bawah.

899943134.source: Overrides the value of the first slot wheel.

221938203.source: Overrides the value of the second slot wheel.

760092450.source: Overrides the value of the third slot wheel.

3934425047.source: Overrides the roulette outcome. 37 is the green 00.
3934425047.text: Timpa hasil Roulette. 37 adalah angka hijau 00.

2738997538.source: You will always win or draw. Only overrides locally.
2738997538.text: Lo selalu menang atau seri. Hanya bekerja secara lokal.

1047105816.source: Set the Story Mode money amount for the chosen character.
1047105816.text: Atur jumlah uang karakter di Story Mode.

481048368.source: Completely reveals the Story Mode map.

1652235666.source: Make the game ask you on the next session change if you want to change your character's appearance.
1652235666.text: Saat ganti sesi, game bakal nanya apakah lo mau ubah tampilan karakter.

905058160.source: Allows you to change your character's gender when you are redesigning them.
905058160.text: Memungkinkan kamu untuk mengubah gender karakter saat mendesain ulang mereka.

1006605288.text: Buka semua kemampuan karakter sampai level maksimal.

2247133388.source: Enable permanent faster running and swimming for your current character.
2247133388.text: Aktifkan lari dan renang lebih cepat secara permanen buat karakter lo.

2730918402.source: Removes the faster running and swimming from your current character again.
2730918402.text: Menghapus kembali kemampuan lari dan renang yang lebih cepat dari karaktermu saat ini.

32187820.source: Give yourself the maximum amount of snacks.
32187820.text: Isi snack lo sampai jumlah maksimal.

289571232.text: Isi armor lo sampai jumlah maksimal.

435175505.source: Unlock all Contract DLC Media/USB Sticks.
435175505.text: Buka semua Media/USB Stick DLC The Contract.

1964121990.source: Allows you to join GTA Online without completing the prologue.
1964121990.text: Memungkinkan kamu untuk masuk ke GTA Online tanpa menyelesaikan prolog.

1409614526.source: Sets many cutscenes and introductions as already viewed, so you will not see them anymore.
1409614526.text: Bikin banyak cutscene dan intro dianggap udah pernah dilihat, jadi gak bakal muncul lagi.

4106260313.source: Set the Los Santos Car Meet level.
4106260313.text: Atur level Los Santos Car Meet.

2295449409.source: Give yourself the Los Santos Car Meet membership for free.
2295449409.text: Dapatkan keanggotaan Los Santos Car Meet secara gratis.

883833287.source: Unlock all Los Santos Car Meet unlocks. Setting the level is not required.
883833287.text: Buka semua unlock Los Santos Car Meet. Gak perlu atur level.

4155069047.source: Completes the Prize Ride Challenges so you can claim the current Prize Ride in LSCM.
4155069047.text: Selesaikan tantangan Prize Ride sehingga lo bisa klaim hadiah di LSCM.

2283485681.source: Unlocks rewards from old seasonal events such as Independence Day, Halloween or Christmas.
2283485681.text: Membuka hadiah dari event musiman lama seperti Hari Kemerdekaan, Halloween, atau Natal.

1374343697.source: Marks every Ghosts Exposed ghost as not photographed, so the ghosts appear again and the hunt can be done again.
1374343697.text: Menandai setiap hantu Ghosts Exposed sebagai belum difoto, sehingga hantu-hantu tersebut muncul kembali dan perburuan dapat dilakukan lagi.

2567890044.source: Sets some missions and challenges as completed.
2567890044.text: Tandai beberapa misi dan tantangan sebagai selesai.

3100536881.source: Unlocks all Freemode Missions and Phone Services.
3100536881.text: Buka semua misi Freemode dan layanan telepon.

1158206419.source: Permanently unlock all Bunker Research projects for your currently active character.
1158206419.text: Buka permanen semua proyek riset Bunker buat karakter lo saat ini.

3263653213.source: Makes you able to booty call all strippers.
3263653213.text: Bikin lo bisa booty call semua stripper.

2683823175.text: Atur popularitas klub malam ke maksimum.

1800720261.source: Clears the heat of all the Money Fronts businesses.
1800720261.text: Membersihkan heat dari semua bisnis Money Fronts.

39985084.source: Clears your Bad Sport status and points. A Bad Sport status Rockstar set on your account stays.
39985084.text: Menghapus status dan poin Bad Sport kamu. Status Bad Sport yang ditetapkan Rockstar pada akunmu akan tetap ada.

1011426261.source: Makes you a Bad Sport. It wears off over time like a normal one, or with Remove Bad Sport.
1011426261.text: Menjadikanmu seorang Bad Sport. Efek ini akan hilang seiring waktu seperti biasanya, atau dengan Hapus Bad Sport.

4274424803.source: Increases the daily payout of the Salvage Yard Safe to the maximum. This decreases again over time, just like nightclub popularity.
4274424803.text: Meningkatkan pendapatan harian Brankas Salvage Yard ke batas maksimum. Ini akan berkurang lagi seiring waktu, sama seperti popularitas klub malam.

4247548701.source: Increases pool sizes for things like peds. Can become unstable when setting a high multiplier.
4247548701.text: Meningkatkan ukuran pool untuk hal-hal seperti NPC. Bisa jadi tidak stabil jika terlalu tinggi.

70235227.source: Increases the size of the pool of memory GTA allocates.
70235227.text: Menambah ukuran pool memori yang dialokasikan oleh GTA.

3130585106.source: A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, including light and other electromagnetic waves, has enough energy to escape it.
3130585106.text: Lubang hitam itu area di ruang-waktu di mana gravitasi super kuat sampe cahaya aja gak bisa kabur.

2804242226.text: Bikin radio bisa dipakai di mana aja.

2486516065.source: Disables the music that would normally play when flying.
2486516065.text: Nonaktifkan musik yang biasanya diputar saat terbang.

1178667231.source: Disables the music that would normally play when having a wanted level.
1178667231.text: Nonaktifkan musik saat lo punya wanted level.

2741035590.source: Forces the lock-on warning sound to play in all vehicles.
2741035590.text: Paksakan suara peringatan lock-on di semua kendaraan.

4057680701.source: Disables seasonal events such as Christmas or Halloween.
4057680701.text: Nonaktifkan event musiman seperti Natal atau Halloween.

3037906839.source: Makes all cutscenes skippable like in story mode.
3037906839.text: Bikin semua cutscene bisa diskip kayak di story mode.

1687155479.source: Allows you to select any of your owned vehicles in a heist.
1687155479.text: Bisa pilih kendaraan milik lo sendiri buat Heist.

1813188296.source: Stops some components of the game from updating, which can break things.
1813188296.text: Menghentikan pembaruan beberapa komponen game, yang dapat merusak fungsi permainan.

1976175879.source: Make all vehicles spin like beyblades.
1976175879.text: Membuat semua kendaraan berputar seperti beyblade.

1688870385.source: Enables some perks and utilities. The game will think you are a Rockstar developer.
1688870385.text: Aktifkan beberapa fitur khusus dan utilities. Game bakal nganggep lo sebagai developer Rockstar.

2557260961.source: Model that will be replaced by the new model.
2557260961.text: Model lama yang bakal diganti sama model baru.

4135479962.source: Model that the old model will be replaced by.
4135479962.text: Model baru yang bakal menggantikan model lama.

3901090501.source: Make new instances of the provided models swapped.
3901090501.text: Bikin semua instance dari model tertentu berubah sesuai swap yang lo atur.

1534713263.source: Notifies you when a new player joins your session.
1534713263.text: Kasih notifikasi pas ada pemain baru yang masuk ke sesi lo.

2579613749.source: Notifies you when a player leaves your session.
2579613749.text: Kasih notifikasi pas ada pemain yang keluar dari sesi lo.

537703078.source: In weapon shops, it will always show any components for the selected weapon.
537703078.text: Di toko senjata, bakal nunjukin semua attachment buat senjata yang dipilih.

610033787.source: Deletes every instance of the selected entity types in the selected area.
610033787.text: Hapus semua entitas yang dipilih dalam area tertentu.

1353094126.source: Overlay a custom color screen filter.
1353094126.text: Terapkan overlay warna khusus di layar.

1455129372.source: Draw a crosshair in the middle of your screen.

728943102.source: Show your system time at the top.
728943102.text: Tampilkan waktu sistem lo di bagian atas.

1852813958.source: Show the Cherax watermark in the top left corner.
1852813958.text: Tampilkan watermark Cherax di pojok kiri atas.

1159182202.source: Show frames per second in the top right corner.
1159182202.text: Tampilkan FPS di pojok kanan atas.

1930574032.source: Adds delimiters for money on the HUD.
1930574032.text: Tambahin pemisah angka buat jumlah uang di HUD.

2170704524.source: Displays news about Cherax during transitions.
2170704524.text: Menampilkan berita tentang Cherax selama transisi.

648996757.source: Show information about what the game does while transitioning into a new session.
648996757.text: Tampilkan info tentang apa yang dilakukan game saat transisi ke sesi baru.

2720913463.source: Disables the loading icon which is usually displayed in the bottom right.
2720913463.text: Matikan ikon loading yang biasanya muncul di pojok kanan bawah.

3337642294.source: Disables the help messages which are usually displayed in the top left.
3337642294.text: Matikan pesan bantuan yang biasanya muncul di pojok kiri atas.

3565962309.source: Makes in-game time the same as the real time.
3565962309.text: Bikin waktu dalam game sama dengan waktu asli.

2002851323.source: Allows you to edit sky settings.
2002851323.text: Bikin lo bisa mengedit pengaturan langit.

1826405126.text: Mencegah lalu lintas baru muncul di map.

4022315046.text: Atur variasi lalu lintas GTA yang biasanya monoton.

3382404845.source: Mirrors the world left to right, with steering, movement, camera, sound, minimap, map and ESP to match. The HUD stays readable.
3382404845.text: Mencerminkan dunia dari kiri ke kanan, dengan kemudi, gerakan, kamera, suara, minimap, peta, dan ESP yang disesuaikan. HUD tetap dapat dibaca.

2152343513.source: Enables the glow effect on some other materials like vehicle glass.
2152343513.text: Mengaktifkan efek glow pada beberapa material lain seperti kaca kendaraan.

4273934411.source: Overrides the glow effect with custom values.
4273934411.text: Menimpa efek glow dengan nilai kustom.

2647764291.source: The intensity of the glow effect.

3690030742.source: The frequency of the glow effect.

173812905.source: Save your current position as a teleport point.
173812905.text: Simpan posisi Anda saat ini sebagai titik teleportasi.

3152352958.source: Load and teleport to a specific position.
3152352958.text: Muat dan teleport ke posisi tertentu.

1152745080.source: Load and teleport all players to a specific position.
1152745080.text: Muat dan teleport semua pemain ke posisi tertentu.

3330900414.source: Always gives you the plushie that you hit.
3330900414.text: Selalu dapet boneka yang lo ambil di mesin capit.

1144775096.source: Makes the arcade game Axe Fury much easier.
1144775096.text: Bikin game Axe Fury jadi lebih gampang.

767974159.source: Forces the outcome of the Love Doctor game.
767974159.text: Paksakan hasil di game Love Doctor.

2968217636.source: Gives you unlimited health or lives in any arcade game.
2968217636.text: Bikin lo punya nyawa atau HP tak terbatas di game arcade.

2389318620.source: Disables the wobble effect in darts.

3092686972.text: Membuat adu panco jauh lebih mudah.

2964868113.source: Disables the wind in golf that impacts your trajectory.
2964868113.text: Matikan efek angin yang mempengaruhi arah bola golf.

1659092553.source: Going through bushes or leaves will no longer hinder the golf ball.
1659092553.text: Bola golf gak bakal ketahan sama daun atau semak-semak.

1289647106.source: Automatically finishes golf holes. If enabled on the first hit, it results in a hole in one.
1289647106.text: Menyelesaikan lubang golf secara otomatis. Jika diaktifkan pada pukulan pertama, akan menghasilkan hole in one.

276243554.source: Disables distance limits for drones and missiles.
276243554.text: Hapus batas jarak buat drone dan misil.

2701392428.source: Makes your drone unable to die.
2701392428.text: Bikin drone lo jadi gak bisa dihancurin.

1152076209.source: Disables collision with lasers like the ones in the Kortz Center Vault.
1152076209.text: Menonaktifkan tabrakan dengan laser seperti yang ada di Vault Kortz Center.

1204021983.source: Block session events that have been started manually by other modders.
1204021983.text: Blokir event sesi yang dimulai secara manual oleh modder lain.

3202215154.source: Blocks some events by doing some sanity checks on them.
3202215154.text: Memblokir beberapa event dengan melakukan sanity check pada event tersebut.

3352613032.source: A good protection against various types of script events. Generally recommended to keep enabled, but you may turn it off for missions.
3352613032.text: Perlindungan yang baik terhadap berbagai jenis script event. Umumnya disarankan untuk tetap diaktifkan, tetapi kamu boleh mematikannya untuk misi.

464776583.source: Specify the duration of the timeout in seconds.

135020076.source: Specify the duration of the timeout in seconds.

2667496122.source: As the host, you can monitor who has connection issues or is drop kicking someone, and even block the kick.
2667496122.text: Sebagai host, kamu dapat memantau siapa yang mengalami masalah koneksi atau sedang melakukan drop kick ke seseorang, dan bahkan memblokir kick tersebut.

4163470087.source: Make your player less considered for kicking when someone is drop kicking you.
4163470087.text: Bikin karakter lo lebih tahan terhadap kick pas ada yang drop kick lo.

247522978.source: Automatically rejoin the session you got desynced from.
247522978.text: Otomatis masuk lagi ke sesi kalau lo disconnect karena desync.

760890038.source: You will get drop kicked instead of being forced to join a new session when receiving a host kick.
760890038.text: Lo bakal kena drop kick daripada dipaksa pindah sesi kalau dapat host kick.

1719623628.source: Prevents players from aiming at you.
1719623628.text: Cegah pemain lain buat ngarahin senjata ke lo.

236161293.source: Prevents players from being able to shoot you, and you to damage them.
236161293.text: Cegah pemain lain buat nembak lo, dan lo gak bisa nge-damage mereka.

2775936621.source: Use a relay to proxy your IP address.
2775936621.text: Gunakan relay buat menyembunyikan alamat IP lo.

851640681.source: Prevents the camera from shaking from things like explosions.
851640681.text: Mencegah kamera berguncang akibat hal-hal seperti ledakan.

3986954131.source: Prevents transaction errors from being displayed.

3831757577.source: Informs you of other players spectating you.
3831757577.text: Kasih tahu lo kalau ada pemain lain yang lagi spectate.

140152725.source: Prevents modders from spectating you. Does not work if the player is near.
140152725.text: Cegah modder dari spectate lo. Tidak bekerja kalau pemain terlalu dekat.

428196836.source: Blocks model swaps of other players.
428196836.text: Blokir perubahan model dari pemain lain.

1108589597.source: World Model Syncs are modded entities. This does not mean the player who synced it is the modder who created it. The models are used for custom maps like races, but can also be used to crash someone.
1108589597.text: World Model Sync adalah entitas modded. Ini bukan berarti pemain yang menyinkronkannya adalah modder yang membuatnya. Model-model ini digunakan untuk map kustom seperti balapan, tetapi juga bisa digunakan untuk meng-crash seseorang.

1460465070.source: Hides God Mode from other modders.
1460465070.text: Menyembunyikan God Mode dari modder lain.

2297827074.source: Hides the damage modifier from other modders. This might affect entity syncing a little bit when using a high melee damage modifier.
2297827074.text: Menyembunyikan damage modifier dari modder lain. Ini mungkin sedikit memengaruhi sinkronisasi entitas saat menggunakan damage modifier melee yang tinggi.

27474110.text: Sembunyikan status Spectating dari modder lain.

4017056149.source: Hides Super Jump from other modders.
4017056149.text: Sembunyikan Super Jump dari modder lain.

73741034.source: Block other modders from using Bounty Claims to trigger transaction errors for you.
73741034.text: Blokir modder lain yang nge-spam bounty buat bikin error transaksi lo.

2013063661.source: Block other modders spamming explosions near you.
2013063661.text: Blokir modder lain yang nge-spam ledakan di sekitar lo.

175738847.source: Block other modders spamming PTFX on you.
175738847.text: Blokir modder lain yang nge-spam efek PTFX ke lo.

3874075188.source: Block other modders spamming sounds on you.
3874075188.text: Blokir modder lain yang nge-spam suara ke lo.

3013869945.source: Block other modders spamming stun gun on you.
3013869945.text: Blokir modder lain yang nge-spam stun gun ke lo.

2155814036.source: Blocks chat messages that include advertising.
2155814036.text: Blokir pesan chat yang berisi iklan.

2764281058.source: Blocks modders from making your phone ring infinitely.
2764281058.text: Blokir modder biar gak bisa bikin HP lo bunyi terus-terusan.

4094095840.source: On a creation, only count entities that look modded/script-spawned toward the density limits. Stops naturally dense areas (parking lots, traffic, crowds) from being false-flagged.
4094095840.text: Saat pembuatan entitas, hanya hitung entitas yang terlihat modded/dispawn oleh skrip menuju batas kepadatan. Mencegah area yang memang padat (tempat parkir, lalu lintas, kerumunan) terdeteksi palsu.

3028278510.source: On a position sync, only run the density check when an entity jumps at least this far in one sync (a teleport). Legit fast movement stays below this; a 'created far, synced near' bypass is a huge jump.
3028278510.text: Pada sinkronisasi posisi, pemeriksaan kepadatan hanya dijalankan saat suatu entitas melompat setidaknya sejauh ini dalam satu sinkronisasi (teleport). Gerakan cepat yang sah tetap di bawah ini; bypass 'dibuat jauh, disinkronkan dekat' merupakan lompatan yang sangat besar.

4208785510.source: Write detailed spam-protection diagnostics to the console so false flags can be investigated. 'Blocks Only' logs every block with the reason; 'Verbose' also logs allowed creations that got close to a limit.
4208785510.text: Tulis diagnostik proteksi spam secara rinci ke konsol agar deteksi palsu dapat diselidiki. 'Hanya Blokir' mencatat setiap pemblokiran beserta alasannya; 'Rinci' juga mencatat pembuatan yang diizinkan yang mendekati batas.

2000617387.source: Rate-limit peds spawned by other players to stop performance-killing ped spam.
2000617387.text: Blokir NPC yang di-spam karena bisa ngaruh ke performa PC lo.

252236411.source: Block story & cutscene peds (Michael, Franklin, Lester, cutscene models, ...) from being network-created. These are a common crash vector and never spawn legitimately online.
252236411.text: Blokir ped cerita & cutscene (Michael, Franklin, Lester, model cutscene, ...) agar tidak dibuat melalui jaringan. Ini adalah vektor crash umum dan tidak pernah muncul secara sah di sesi online.

2188248770.source: Only count peds that look modded/script-spawned. Big reduction in false flags, at the cost of letting non-modded floods through.
2188248770.text: Hanya menghitung ped yang terlihat modded/dispawn oleh skrip. Mengurangi deteksi palsu secara signifikan, namun banjir entitas non-modded bisa lolos.

2613206724.source: Also rate-limit random/ambient population peds, not just mission-scripted ones. Can false flag in busy areas.
2613206724.text: Juga membatasi laju populasi ped acak/sekitar, bukan hanya yang berasal dari skrip misi. Bisa memicu deteksi palsu di area ramai.

1628932951.source: How aggressively ped spam is blocked. Lenient/Normal/Strict apply presets to the advanced sliders below; pick Custom (or just drag a slider) to fine-tune.
1628932951.text: Seberapa agresif spam ped diblokir. Ringan/Normal/Ketat menerapkan preset ke slider lanjutan di bawah; pilih Kustom (atau cukup geser slider) untuk menyesuaikan.

1064559109.source: Length of the ped rate-limit window in milliseconds.
1064559109.text: Durasi jendela pembatasan laju ped dalam milidetik.

283390042.source: How many peds one player may create within the window before further peds are blocked.
283390042.text: Berapa banyak ped yang boleh dibuat oleh satu pemain dalam jendela sebelum ped berikutnya diblokir.

1567480449.source: How many repeats of the same ped model one player may create within the window before blocking.
1567480449.text: Berapa kali pengulangan model ped yang sama boleh dibuat oleh satu pemain dalam jendela sebelum diblokir.

2475999622.source: Block creates/syncs that would pack too many peds around a point near you. Also runs on position syncs, so peds created far away and teleported next to you are caught.
2475999622.text: Blokir pembuatan/sinkronisasi yang menumpuk terlalu banyak ped di sekitar titik di dekatmu. Juga berjalan pada sinkronisasi posisi, sehingga ped yang dibuat jauh lalu diteleportasikan ke sampingmu ikut tertangkap dan diblokir.

2682202179.source: Radius of the close-range ped density band, in meters.
2682202179.text: Radius rentang kepadatan ped jarak dekat, dalam meter.

1916562904.source: Max peds allowed within the close radius before further peds are blocked.
1916562904.text: Maksimal ped yang diizinkan dalam radius dekat sebelum ped berikutnya diblokir.

2196619016.source: Radius of the far-range ped density band, in meters.
2196619016.text: Radius rentang kepadatan ped jarak jauh, dalam meter.

1575198400.source: Max peds allowed within the far radius before further peds are blocked.
1575198400.text: Maksimal ped yang diizinkan dalam radius jauh sebelum ped berikutnya diblokir.

3402425053.source: Rate-limit vehicles spawned by other players, with a tighter cap for large/weaponised vehicles that lag the game.
3402425053.text: Blokir kendaraan besar yang bisa nge-lag game lo kalau kebanyakan.

3318002338.source: Only count vehicles that look modded/script-spawned. Big reduction in false flags.
3318002338.text: Hanya menghitung kendaraan yang terlihat modded/dispawn oleh skrip. Mengurangi deteksi palsu secara signifikan.

1942762183.source: Also rate-limit random/ambient/parked traffic, not just mission-scripted vehicles. Can false flag in heavy traffic.
1942762183.text: Juga membatasi laju lalu lintas acak/sekitar/parkir, bukan hanya kendaraan dari skrip misi. Bisa memicu deteksi palsu saat lalu lintas padat.

1640634404.source: How aggressively vehicle spam is blocked. Lenient/Normal/Strict apply presets to the advanced sliders below; pick Custom (or just drag a slider) to fine-tune.
1640634404.text: Seberapa agresif spam kendaraan diblokir. Ringan/Normal/Ketat menerapkan preset ke slider lanjutan di bawah; pilih Kustom (atau cukup geser slider) untuk menyesuaikan.

4027996778.source: Length of the vehicle rate-limit window in milliseconds.
4027996778.text: Durasi jendela pembatasan laju kendaraan dalam milidetik.

421962871.source: How many vehicles one player may create within the window before further vehicles are blocked.
421962871.text: Berapa banyak kendaraan yang boleh dibuat oleh satu pemain dalam jendela sebelum kendaraan berikutnya diblokir.

1670144478.source: How many repeats of the same vehicle model one player may create within the window before blocking.
1670144478.text: Berapa kali pengulangan model kendaraan yang sama boleh dibuat oleh satu pemain dalam jendela sebelum diblokir.

968049036.source: Tighter cap for large / weaponised / aircraft / boats within the window.
968049036.text: Batas lebih ketat untuk kendaraan besar / bersenjata / pesawat / perahu dalam jendela.

1461067788.text: Maks Kendaraan Besar yang Sama / Jendela
